messages:
olivia-sales: Heads up — ValenceRetail POC: stream via corp proxy intermittently returns 502/504 and their TS/Python clients retry, causing duplicate first chunks. Call in 25. Need quick triage checklist.
hamid-eng: is it SSE or chunked? proxy type?
olivia-sales: chunked HTTP/1.1 through a TLS-terminating corporate proxy that imposes a 12s idle cutoff.
carmen-ps: common pattern: proxy drops idle connection, client retries entire request, app sees repeated first chunk. Two quick fixes to ask them to try pre-call.
devon-devex: checklist to send now: 1) enable keepAlive on client agent; 2) disable automatic retries for streaming endpoints; 3) add a tiny heartbeat every 5s; 4) include X-Idempotency-Key or X-Stream-Seq to allow dedupe. Add curl reproducer.
sre-bot: Incident SR-2026-0891 created and tcpdump requested.
hamid-eng: Node snippet: `const agent=new https.Agent({keepAlive:true}); fetch(url,{agent,headers:{'Connection':'keep-alive','X-Idempotency-Key':id}})` — set read timeout to 0. Python snippet: mount HTTPAdapter with max_retries=0 and pool_maxsize=1.
customer-liu: we can test keepAlive and heartbeat but cannot change their proxy policy. Relay option?
carmen-ps: we can propose temporary relay in nearest region to terminate our stream and forward via a short-lived connection to them. Offer 2-week relay credit + 4 engineer hours. Need approval from sales.
olivia-sales: please draft offer text. Also can server do permissive dedupe for POC?
hamid-eng: yes — for POC we can enable server-side dedupe using X-Redwood-Stream-Id + sequence id, drop duplicates for 120s window. Not for GA.
devon-devex: sending the quick checklist + curl/Node/Python reproducer now in a separate message.
sre-bot: Logs attached: /attachments/SR-2026-0891/edge-trace.tgz
customer-liu: trying client changes now, will update before call. Thanks. :thumbsup:
